blocks.title: Directions
blocks.md: The four main directions are **North (N)**, **South (S)**, **East (E)** and **West (W)**. The Sun rises in the **east** and sets in the **west**. A **compass** shows the directions.

blocks.caption: A compass with the four main directions.
blocks.alt: A cross with N at the top, S at the bottom, E on the right and W on the left.

blocks.title: Maps
blocks.md: A **map** is a drawing of a place seen from above. A **key** explains the signs. A **title** tells what the map shows. A **compass rose** shows north. A **scale** shows how big distances are.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- East and west are not the same.
- North is usually at the top of the map.
- Read the key to understand the signs.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: In which direction does the Sun rise?

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: If you face north, which direction is behind you?

lessons.title: Where is Cameroon?
lessons.programRef: MINEDUB primary school curriculum (English-speaking subsystem), Level II (Class 3) — Social Studies; to be checked against the official texts
lessons.author: CastBridge (AI draft)
lessons.source: Original writing following the Cameroonian curriculum; to be reviewed by a teacher
objectives: Say where Cameroon is in Africa.
reviewNotes: Neighbours and directions are standard (Equatorial Guinea, Gabon and Republic of the Congo to the south). Border lengths and areas are left out.
Syllabus references, scope and level of difficulty are to be checked against the official text; all facts, formulas and worked examples to be verified by a teacher before release.

blocks.title: Location
blocks.md: Cameroon is in **Central Africa**, near the **Equator**. It has a coast on the **Atlantic Ocean** (Gulf of Guinea). It looks a little like a triangle. The capital is **Yaoundé**; the biggest city and main port is **Douala**.

blocks.caption: Neighbours of Cameroon.
blocks.alt: Six boxes with the neighbours of Cameroon.

blocks.title: Neighbours
blocks.md: Cameroon's neighbours are **Nigeria** (west), **Chad** (north-east), the **Central African Republic** (east), and the **Republic of the Congo**, **Gabon** and **Equatorial Guinea** (south). Six neighbours in all.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Cameroon is not in West Africa only: we say Central Africa.
- Nigeria is to the west, not the east.
- Count neighbouring countries: six.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: Which country is to the west of Cameroon?

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: On which ocean does Cameroon have a coast?
steps: Cameroon is in the Gulf of Guinea.

objectives: Name the ten regions and their capitals.
Group regions: north, centre, south, west.
reviewNotes: Regions, capitals and the two-region English-speaking statement are standard; wording of official language use should be checked.
Syllabus references, scope and level of difficulty are to be checked against the official text; all facts, formulas and worked examples to be verified by a teacher before release.

blocks.title: Ten regions
blocks.md: Cameroon has **ten regions**. Each has a regional capital. **Far North** (Maroua), **North** (Garoua) and **Adamawa** (Ngaoundéré) are in the north. **East** (Bertoua), **Centre** (Yaoundé) and **South** (Ebolowa) are in the centre and south.

blocks.caption: Regions and capitals.
blocks.alt: Ten boxes with each region and its capital.

blocks.title: West and coast
blocks.md: **West** (Bafoussam), **North-West** (Bamenda), **South-West** (Buea) and **Littoral** (Douala) are in the west and on the coast. The North-West and South-West regions are the two English-speaking regions; French is more widely used in the other eight.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Bamenda is in the North-West, Buea is in the South-West.
- Yaoundé (Centre) is the capital of Cameroon.
- The Littoral is the coast region, with Douala.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: Which region has Bafoussam as its capital?

objectives: Name Mount Cameroon and some rivers and lakes.
Say why rivers and mountains are useful.
reviewNotes: Height 'about 4,000 m' is approximate. The Sanaga is described as the longest river wholly within Cameroon in many textbooks; check wording.
Syllabus references, scope and level of difficulty are to be checked against the official text; all facts, formulas and worked examples to be verified by a teacher before release.

blocks.title: Relief
blocks.md: **Relief** means the shape of the land. Cameroon has coastal plains, plateaus, highlands and plains in the north. **Mount Cameroon** is the highest mountain in the country, near Buea in the South-West Region. It is an active volcano, about 4,000 metres high.

blocks.caption: Some natural features.
blocks.alt: Four boxes: Mount Cameroon, Sanaga, Wouri, Lake Chad.

blocks.title: Rivers and lakes
blocks.md: Important rivers: the **Sanaga** (the longest river in Cameroon), the **Wouri** (near Douala), the **Benue** and the **Logone**. **Lake Chad** is in the far north, shared with other countries. **Lake Nyos** is a small crater lake in the North-West.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Mount Cameroon is in the South-West, not in the North.
- Rivers can give water, fish, transport and electricity.
- Do not swim in rivers you do not know.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: In which region is Mount Cameroon?

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: Name two uses of a river.
steps: Rivers give water and produce electricity.

objectives: Describe the hotter, drier north and the wetter south.
Name crops and products of Cameroon.
reviewNotes: Climate and crop zones are described in broad terms only; check with the textbook for regional details.
Syllabus references, scope and level of difficulty are to be checked against the official text; all facts, formulas and worked examples to be verified by a teacher before release.

blocks.title: Climate
blocks.md: **Climate** is the usual weather of a place. The south and coast have a **hot and wet** climate with much rain. The north is **hotter and drier** with a long dry season. The highlands are **cooler**.

blocks.caption: Some cash crops.
blocks.alt: Six boxes with cocoa, coffee, banana, oil palm, tea, cotton.

blocks.title: Farming and products
blocks.md: Many people are **farmers**. Food crops: cassava, maize, plantain, yams, beans, millet and sorghum (more in the north). Cash crops: **cocoa** and **coffee**, **bananas**, **oil palm**, **rubber**, **tea** (on highlands) and **cotton** (north). Cameroon also has forests, fish, petroleum and timber.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Cotton grows mainly in the north, cocoa in the forest zone.
- Not every region grows every crop.
- Cutting forests needs care and new planting.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: Which part of Cameroon is hotter and drier?

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: Name a cash crop grown in the forest zone.
